signature: SUBROUTINE DLARRC( JOBT, N, VL, VU, D, E, PIVMIN,

params.name: jobt
params.reference:
-   `= 'T'`: Compute Sturm count for matrix T.
-   `= 'L'`: Compute Sturm count for matrix L D L^T.

params.name: vl
params.reference: The lower bound for the eigenvalues.

params.name: vu
params.reference: The upper bound for the eigenvalues.

params.name: d
params.reference: `JOBT = 'T'`: The N diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T. `JOBT = 'L'`: The N diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D.

params.name: e
params.reference: `JOBT = 'T'`: The N-1 offdiagonal elements of the matrix T. `JOBT = 'L'`: The N-1 offdiagonal elements of the matrix L.

params.name: pivmin
params.reference: The minimum pivot in the Sturm sequence for T.

params.name: eigcnt
params.reference: The number of eigenvalues of the symmetric tridiagonal matrix T that are in the interval (`VL`,`VU`\]

params.name: rcnt
params.reference: The left and right negcounts of the interval.
